# pve_node_disk_lvmthin (Resource)

LVM-thin pool created on a node's disk(s). Read filters the list endpoint on the thin-LV name (create `name` == list `lv`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_node_disk_lvmthin" "example" {
device = "CHANGE_ME"
name = "CHANGE_ME"
node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) The block device you want to create the thinpool on.
- `name` (String) The storage identifier.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `add_storage` (Boolean) Configure storage using the thinpool. (default: 0)
- `cleanup_config` (Boolean) Marks associated storage(s) as not available on this node anymore or removes them from the configuration (if configured for this node only). (default: 0)
- `cleanup_disks` (Boolean) Also wipe disks so they can be repurposed afterwards. (default: 0)
- `volume_group` (String) The storage identifier.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node/name (also the `terraform import` format).
